motion.review: All keyframe sheets reviewed. Acceptance reviewed desktop and first four landscape groups; root independently completed landscape 3-3 valve-lift, 3-4 turn-inner/turn-light/valve-lift and cloud-1/2/3. Root also reviewed desktop rotation and cloud bridge intermediate originals.

findings: Physical horizontal treads and vertical risers visible in every stair orientation.
External stair connections flatten while modules move and rebuild after docking; fixed stairs remain.
Growth preserves full cross sections; retraction removes immediately; undo/replay leaves no remnants.
Stopped feet meet treads; no new visible stair seam or depth defect in reviewed samples.
scope: Manual visual review of listed keyframes and original samples. Continuous frames retained, not every continuous frame manually reviewed. This is not a performance or all-device guarantee.
